description: Gene cluster and substrate-supply inventory for C. leptum DSM 753
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp
import pandas as pd

# Verified from the UniProt REST API for taxon 428125 (2917 entries)
genes=[("CH238_05250","speD","AdoMetDC","A0A855A7R2",1),
       ("CH238_05255","-","hypothetical","A7VSF5",0),
       ("CH238_05260","-","DUF6199","A7VSF6",0),
       ("CH238_05265","speA","arginine decarboxylase","A7VSF7",1),
       ("CH238_05270","-","hypothetical","A7VSF8",0),
       ("CH238_05275","speE","spermidine synthase / aminopropyltransferase","A7VSF9",1),
       ("CH238_05280","speB","agmatinase family ureohydrolase","A0A855A6N2",1),
       ("CH238_05285","CLOLEP_01502","ASA-dependent dehydrogenase (saccharopine-DH fold)","A7VSG1",2),
       ("CH238_05290","CLOLEP_01503","carboxypolyamine decarboxylase (PDB 9EAF)","A7VSG2",3),
       ("CH238_05295","cysK","cysteine synthase","A0A855A871",0)]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(14,8),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1,1.15]})
ax=axes[0]
cols={0:"#d9dce1",1:"#8fb8de",2:"#f0a35e",3:"#2f5d9e"}
x=0
for lt,sym,desc,acc,c in genes:
    w=2.4
    ax.add_patch(mp.FancyArrow(x,0,w,0,width=0.5,head_width=0.5,head_length=0.45,
                               length_includes_head=True,color=cols[c]))
    ax.text(x+w/2,0.52,sym,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=9,rotation=0)
    ax.text(x+w/2,-0.55,desc,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.5,wrap=True)
    ax.text(x+w/2,-0.95,acc,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=6.5,color="#555")
    x+=w+0.35
ax.set_xlim(-0.5,x); ax.set_ylim(-1.6,1.3); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Polyamine gene cluster of [Clostridium] leptum DSM 753 (UniProt taxon 428125, locus tags CH238_05250-05295)\n"
             "CLOLEP_01502 = CH238_05285 (A7VSG1) is immediately upstream of CLOLEP_01503 = CH238_05290 (A7VSG2)",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
rows=[("agmatine","arginine decarboxylase A7VSF7 (CH238_05265)","present","yes"),
      ("putrescine","agmatinase-family A0A855A6N2 (CH238_05280); no ornithine decarboxylase in proteome","present (annotation-level)","yes"),
      ("1,3-diaminopropane","L-2,4-diaminobutyrate aminotransferase / decarboxylase","ABSENT (0 hits)","no"),
      ("aspartate beta-semialdehyde","asd A7VX16 (CH238_01900)","present","yes"),
      ("dcAdoMet","speD A0A855A7R2 (CH238_05250) + speE A7VSF9 (CH238_05275)","present","yes")]
ax.axis("off")
tb=ax.table(cellText=[[r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3]] for r in rows],
            colLabels=["precursor needed","gene(s) in C. leptum DSM 753","status","substrate can be supplied"],
            cellLoc="left",loc="upper center",colWidths=[0.17,0.46,0.19,0.18])
tb.auto_set_font_size(False); tb.set_fontsize(8.5); tb.scale(1,1.7)
for (r,c),cell in tb.get_celld().items():
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#2f5d9e"); cell.set_text_props(color="white",fontweight="bold")
    elif rows[r-1][3]=="no": cell.set_facecolor("#f7d9d9")
ax.set_title("Substrate availability test: carboxynorspermidine needs 1,3-diaminopropane, which this genome cannot make\n"
             "(no diaminobutyrate aminotransferase/decarboxylase, the V. cholerae CANSDC-pathway supply enzyme, PMID 19196710)",fontsize=10,y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["precursor","genes","status","available"]).to_csv("substrate_supply_table.csv",index=False)
print(pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["precursor","genes","status","available"]).to_string(index=False))
